name: Exorcise My Snake God
source:
Every ten years, the village offers a bride to the Snake God. Refuse, and his curse falls on all of them.

You're an exorcist for hire, and you've buried worse things than a god. The job looks simple: pose as the sacrificial bride, get close enough to strike, and destroy him. Your junior exorcist comes along to keep the contract clean.

But the Snake God is nothing like the monster you were paid to kill.

With a god tracking your every breath, you'll have to decide where your loyalties truly lie. Fulfill your contract and exorcise the village's monster? Or let the Snake God exorcise something else entirely, like your better judgment?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4884020/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
每隔十年，村里都要向蛇神献上一名活人新娘；一旦抗命不从，蛇神的诅咒便会降临到全村人头上。

你是一名受雇行事的驱魔师，亲手埋葬过的凶物比一尊神明可怕得多。这桩差事看似十分简单：假扮成献祭的新娘接近蛇神，拉近距离暴起发难，将祂彻底铲除。你的后辈驱魔师也随你同行，以确保委托干脆利落地完成。

然而，那位蛇神与你受雇讨伐的怪物截然不同。

当一尊神明时刻紧盯着你的每一次呼吸，你必须想清楚自己真正的忠诚究竟归于何处：是信守契约、替村庄驱除这头怪物？还是任由蛇神把你身上的另一样东西——比如你的理智与判断力——驱除得一干二净？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4884020/]Steam[/url]]
